docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,500.00 FILED BY BROOKS, ROBERTA AS TO DEFENDANT VELEZ, ERICK ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR MAY-29-2007 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
APPLICATION OF WAIVER OF COURT FEES AND COSTS GRANTED.
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT VELEZ, ERICK

SMALL CLAIMS DISPOSITION MAY-29-2007, CONTINUED BY COURT TO AUG-15-2007 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506 SETTLEMENT PENDING. PURSUANT TO AGREEMENT OF PARTIES, DEFENDANT TO PAY PLAINTIFF $800, IN TWO INSTALLMENTS OF $400 EACH. PAYMENTS TO BE MADE ON JUNE 29, 2007, AND JULY 29, 2007 AT 7:30 PM
RESPECTIVELY, IN THE FORM OF CASH OR MONEY ORDER PAYABLE TO PLFT. IF INSTALLMENT TERMS SATISFIED, PARTIES NEED NOT APPEAR ON 8/15/07 HEARING: COURT

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF BROOKS, ROBERTA RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT VELEZ, ERICK $1,381.00 PRINCIPAL, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,381.00, THE JUDGMENT REFLECTS A CREDIT FOR THE $60.00 PAYMENT PREVIOUSLY MADE BY DEFENDANT. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
